articles.title: Antonelli tops FP2 as Gasly crashes heavily at Spa
articles.description: Alpine's Pierre causes a red flag with a heavy crash in Friday practice at the Belgian Grand Prix as Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli set out his stall for the weekend with fastest time.

articles.title: Norris to have 10-place grid penalty in Belgium
articles.description: Lando Norris will have a 10-place grid penalty at the Belgian Grand Prix as a result of exceeding the permitted number of engine parts.

articles.title: Red Bull to change wing after Verstappen crashes
articles.description: Red Bull are reverting to a conventional rear wing for the Belgian Grand Prix following high-speed crashes for Max Verstappen in the previous two races.
